title: AKS · Rightsizing request & limits
description: Raccomandazioni di CPU/memory request e limit per workload e container (Azure Managed Prometheus). Ogni metrica pesante è interrogata una sola volta: i calcoli li fa Grafana. Range consigliato: max 5 giorni (oltre, il workspace WEU va in 504).

list.name: percentile
list.label: Percentile request
list.description: Percentile dell'uso su cui calcolare la request.

list.name: req_headroom
list.label: Margine request %
list.description: Margine aggiunto al percentile per la request.

list.name: lim_headroom
list.label: Margine limit %
list.description: Margine aggiunto al picco osservato per il limit.

panels.description: Attuale - consigliata. Negativo = sottodimensionato. I container senza request contano solo nel consigliato.

panels.description: Somma memory request x repliche (pod in esecuzione).

panels.description: Somma request consigliate x repliche attuali.

panels.description: Attuale - consigliata. Negativo = sottodimensionato. I container senza request contano solo nel consigliato.

panels.description: Container in esecuzione senza CPU o memory request (QoS BestEffort/Burstable).

targets.expr: count(((max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod, workload) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{namespace="$namespace", workload=~"$workload"})) unless on (namespace, pod, container) (max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD", resource="cpu"}) and max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD", resource="memory"}))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Restart nel periodo
panels.description: Restart dei container nel periodo analizzato.

targets.expr: sum(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__range]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod, workload) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{namespace="$namespace", workload=~"$workload"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: CPU  ·  request = p${percentile} uso +${req_headroom}%  ·  limit = picco +${lim_headroom}%
Raccomandazioni CPU per workload / container
panels.description: Valori in millicore pronti da copiare (request arrotondata a 5m, min 10m; limit a 10m e mai sotto la request). Uso = max tra le repliche. Se il workload ha un HPA su CPU, cambiare la request cambia anche il punto di scaling.

targets.expr: label_join(count by (namespace, workload, container) ((max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{namespace="$namespace", workload=~"$workload"})), "item", " / ", "workload", "container")

label_join(max by (namespace, workload, container) ((max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD", resource="cpu"}) * 1000) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{namespace="$namespace", workload=~"$workload"})), "item", " / ", "workload", "container")

label_join(max by (namespace, workload, container) ((max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD", resource="cpu"}) * 1000) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{namespace="$namespace", workload=~"$workload"})), "item", " / ", "workload", "container")

label_join(max by (namespace, workload, container) ((max by (namespace, pod, container) (quantile_over_time($percentile, rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}[5m])[$__range:5m])) * 1000) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (max_over_time(namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{namespace="$namespace", workload=~"$workload"}[$__range]))), "item", " / ", "workload", "container")

label_join(max by (namespace, workload, container) ((max by (namespace, pod, container) (max_over_time(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}[2m])[$__range:2m])) * 1000) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (max_over_time(namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{namespace="$namespace", workload=~"$workload"}[$__range]))), "item", " / ", "workload", "container")

label_join(max by (namespace, workload, container) ((sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__range])) / sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__range]) > 0) * 100) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (max_over_time(namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{namespace="$namespace", workload=~"$workload"}[$__range]))), "item", " / ", "workload", "container")

(label_join(count by (namespace, workload, container) ((max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{namespace="$namespace", workload=~"$workload"})), "item", " / ", "workload", "container")) * 0 + (1 + $req_headroom / 100)

(label_join(count by (namespace, workload, container) ((max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{namespace="$namespace", workload=~"$workload"})), "item", " / ", "workload", "container")) * 0 + (1 + $lim_headroom / 100)

panels.title: Memoria  ·  request = p${percentile} working set +${req_headroom}%  ·  limit = picco +${lim_headroom}%
Raccomandazioni memoria per workload / container
panels.description: Valori in MiB pronti da copiare (arrotondati a 16Mi, min 32Mi; limit mai sotto la request). Working set = la metrica usata dall'OOM killer. Per la memoria molti team usano limit = request (QoS Guaranteed).

targets.expr: label_join(count by (namespace, workload, container) ((max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{namespace="$namespace", workload=~"$workload"})), "item", " / ", "workload", "container")

label_join(max by (namespace, workload, container) ((max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD", resource="memory"}) / 1048576) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{namespace="$namespace", workload=~"$workload"})), "item", " / ", "workload", "container")

label_join(max by (namespace, workload, container) ((max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD", resource="memory"}) / 1048576) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{namespace="$namespace", workload=~"$workload"})), "item", " / ", "workload", "container")

label_join(max by (namespace, workload, container) ((max by (namespace, pod, container) (quantile_over_time($percentile, container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__range])) / 1048576) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (max_over_time(namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{namespace="$namespace", workload=~"$workload"}[$__range]))), "item", " / ", "workload", "container")

label_join(max by (namespace, workload, container) ((max by (namespace, pod, container) (max_over_time(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__range])) / 1048576) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (max_over_time(namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{namespace="$namespace", workload=~"$workload"}[$__range]))), "item", " / ", "workload", "container")

label_join(max by (namespace, workload, container) ((max by (namespace, pod, container) (max_over_time(kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD", reason="OOMKilled"}[$__range]))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (max_over_time(namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{namespace="$namespace", workload=~"$workload"}[$__range]))), "item", " / ", "workload", "container")

label_join(sum by (namespace, workload, container) ((sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__range]))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (max_over_time(namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{namespace="$namespace", workload=~"$workload"}[$__range]))), "item", " / ", "workload", "container")

(label_join(count by (namespace, workload, container) ((max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{namespace="$namespace", workload=~"$workload"})), "item", " / ", "workload", "container")) * 0 + (1 + $req_headroom / 100)

(label_join(count by (namespace, workload, container) ((max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{namespace="$namespace", workload=~"$workload"})), "item", " / ", "workload", "container")) * 0 + (1 + $lim_headroom / 100)

max by (container) ((sum by (namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{namespace="$namespace", workload="$workload"}))

max by (container) ((max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD", resource="cpu"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{namespace="$namespace", workload="$workload"}))
